answer: One sybil defense: require each agent to post a refundable stake bond, slashable on misbehavior, before its signatures count. Honest identities are rare as a pearl because forging a thousand of them means locking a thousand bonds. Each agent also carries a cipher-signed reputation history that peers verify, so a fresh fake has no track record. Spinning up sybils then feels like homesteading frozen tundra: vast, costly, and barren of return.
